name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.LeafView.floodColumn_close
title: Flooding preimage sampling for any matrix: coset-Gaussian closeness
statement: For any M in Z_q^{n x m} with a short preimage map d (M d(v) = v, |d(v)_j| <= b), tau >= 1, tau sqrt(m) + b <= tau m and dualMassE M tau <= 1/2: the law of y + d(u - M y), y <- D_{Z^m,tau}, is within 2 theta + 6 m 4^{-m} + 3 2^m 4^{-m^2} of the coset Gaussian of {x : M x = u}, theta = pi m (b^2 + 2 tau m b)/tau^2. Generalizes SigabaNeoStd's Trapdoor.Family.colLaw_close (M = Bmat).
